name: Daniel Ashworth
headline: Building enduring companies through disciplined growth.
intro: Twenty years leading global organisations across financial services, infrastructure and technology, with a focus on long-term value, strong governance and people.
aboutBody: Daniel leads Meridian Group, a diversified holding company with operations across Europe, the Middle East and Asia-Pacific. Since taking the helm in 2017 he has refocused the portfolio on core infrastructure and financial services, completed eleven acquisitions and doubled operating margin.
He holds an MBA from INSEAD and a degree in Economics from the London School of Economics, and is a Fellow of the Chartered Institute for Securities & Investment.

principles.title: Long-term value
principles.body: Decisions measured in decades, not quarters.

principles.title: Clear governance
principles.body: Accountability at every level of the organisation.

career.note: Led portfolio restructuring, eleven acquisitions and entry into four new markets; doubled operating margin.
Integrated three operating divisions into a single platform and delivered a £240M efficiency programme.
Built the regional infrastructure practice from inception to £3.5B under management.
Advised boards in financial services and utilities on growth strategy and M&A.

projects.title: Northern Energy Corridor
projects.body: A cross-border grid interconnector linking renewable generation in the North Sea to industrial demand in four countries.

projects.title: Meridian Capital merger
projects.body: Combined two asset management businesses into a single platform with one operating model, brand and leadership team.

projects.title: Canary Quarter regeneration
projects.body: A mixed-use waterfront development delivered in partnership with the city, combining offices, housing and public space.

projects.title: Asia-Pacific market entry
projects.body: Established regional headquarters in Singapore and built operations across five new markets within three years.

techIntro: The platforms and partners behind our operations, chosen for scale, security and long-term reliability across every operating company.
